name: A Night With Mr. Blacke
source:
What was supposed to be a simple babysitting job for an old family friend goes awry when you finally meet your employer, the wealthy and eccentric Simon Blacke. Discover about the unconventional lifestyle that his fortune allows him and indulge his interests for the night in 'A Night with Mr. Blacke'.

[From [url=https://12games.itch.io/a-night-with-mr-blacke]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你终于见到你的雇主，富有而古怪的西蒙·布莱克时，原本应该是为一位老朋友做的简单的保姆工作却出了差错。在“与布莱克先生共度一夜”中了解他的财富允许他过上非传统的生活方式，并在夜晚尽情享受他的兴趣。

[来自[url=https://12games.itch.io/a-night-with-mr-blacke]Itch.io[/url]]
